scenes.title: Start on the same Wi-Fi
scenes.narration: Welcome to GlintBeam, a product by A. I Looplabs. Turn on your TV and connect your phone to the same trusted Wi-Fi network.

scenes.title: Search for your television
scenes.narration: Read the setup tips, then choose Search for TVs. This walkthrough uses example TV data. Follow the prompts for your own television.

scenes.title: Select your TV
scenes.narration: Choose your TV from the list and start its connection process. Check the name and brand. Demo TV is only an example.

scenes.title: Follow the TV’s prompt
scenes.narration: Depending on the brand, approve a TV prompt or enter its required code. Roku does not need a PIN. Wait for GlintBeam to confirm authorization.

scenes.title: Name, assign and save
scenes.narration: After pairing is confirmed, name the TV, choose a room, and select Save and Open Remote. Your saved profile is stored on this phone.

scenes.title: Navigate with arrows and OK
scenes.narration: Use the directional arrows to move and OK to select. Scroll for Back, Home, volume and channel controls. Check the television for each result.

scenes.title: Try the touchpad
scenes.narration: Select Swipe Touchpad to use gestures. Swipe to navigate, tap to select, and double-tap to go back. Supported behavior depends on the TV.

scenes.title: Explore TV shortcuts
scenes.narration: Movie Center contains search, playback, app, and input requests. GlintBeam does not supply streaming content. Availability depends on your TV and its services.

scenes.title: Type or choose voice
scenes.narration: Open the keyboard or microphone button to send text. Voice is optional. Read its explanation before allowing microphone access; typed input is also available.

scenes.title: Find your saved TVs
scenes.narration: Use TVs and Setup to switch televisions, filter rooms, add devices, or remove a saved TV. Removing a device also clears its saved pairing credentials.

scenes.title: Use the Brand Guide
scenes.narration: Open Brand Guide for setup instructions. Native Android and Google TV pairing is not supported in this version. Controls vary by model and protocol.

scenes.title: Help is always nearby
scenes.narration: Use Privacy and Info for disclosures and notices. Visit the GlintBeam website for the complete manual and support. You are ready to try the basic remote controls.

scenes.title: Meet GlintBeam
scenes.narration: Start with your phone and television on the same trusted Wi-Fi network. Turn the television on. GlintBeam is a product by A. I Looplabs. This guide uses labeled example TV data.

scenes.title: Before you connect
scenes.narration: Read the first-use tips and select Next Tip to continue. These screenshots show example interface states, not a recording of a physical television responding. Supported controls depend on the TV model.

scenes.title: Learn the navigation modes
scenes.narration: GlintBeam offers a directional pad and a swipe touchpad. The setup tips introduce both modes. Later, you can switch between them on the Remote screen and use whichever feels more comfortable.

scenes.title: Search, apps and voice
scenes.narration: The next tip introduces TV app shortcuts, typed searches, and optional voice input. GlintBeam sends requests to your selected TV. Streaming services may require their own accounts, payments, or subscriptions.

scenes.title: Begin TV discovery
scenes.narration: Choose Search for TVs. Keep the phone and TV on the same local network. You can revisit the previous tip with Back. The tutorial checkbox controls whether these tips appear again.

scenes.title: If no television appears
scenes.narration: If discovery finds nothing, confirm the TV is on and connected to the same Wi-Fi. Try Rescan Wi-Fi. Guest networks or network isolation can prevent devices from finding each other.

scenes.title: Choose the correct TV
scenes.narration: Select your television from the discovered list, then use the blue pairing button. Demo TV is an example. Confirm the name and brand belong to the television you intend to control.

scenes.title: Connect using an IP address
scenes.narration: If discovery misses your TV, use the manual connection section. Choose its brand and enter the TV address shown in its network settings. Do not enter an address copied from this example.

scenes.title: Approve on the television
scenes.narration: Some TVs, including Samsung, show an approval request on the television. Allow GlintBeam there and wait for confirmation. This is an illustrated app state; your actual television prompt may look different.

scenes.title: Enter the TV’s own code
scenes.narration: Other televisions request a PIN or configured key. Enter the value from your television or its authorized settings, then verify. Never assume the sample code in a tutorial will pair a real TV.

scenes.title: Handle a rejected pairing
scenes.narration: If authorization fails, the pairing screen stays open. Check the TV, request a new prompt, or go back and select the device again. A failed request does not mean the TV is connected.

scenes.title: Give your TV a useful name
scenes.narration: After the television confirms pairing, choose a recognizable name, such as Living Room TV. Assign a room so multiple televisions are easier to find. The saved profile remains in GlintBeam on this phone.

scenes.title: Save and open the remote
scenes.narration: Choose Save and Open Remote after pairing and naming your television. The app then opens the main remote. The example shown here illustrates the destination; it is not evidence of hardware compatibility.

scenes.title: Use the directional pad
scenes.narration: Tap the directional arrows to move through the television interface. Tap OK to select. The top row includes power, source, the number pad, and keyboard or voice access. Check the TV for each result.

scenes.title: Switch to swipe navigation
scenes.narration: Choose Swipe Touchpad. Swipe to navigate, tap to select, and double-tap to go back. These gestures send navigation requests; smooth pointer movement and other behavior depend on the selected TV protocol.

scenes.title: Find Back, Home and volume
scenes.narration: Scroll down the remote to reach Back, Home, Movies, Guide, Menu, volume, mute, and channel controls. Some controls depend on your TV. Displayed information is not a continuously synchronized TV status feed.

scenes.title: Open Movie Center
scenes.narration: Use the bottom Movie Center tab for TV search and playback requests. Type a movie, show, or actor and send the search to your TV. GlintBeam does not supply movies or guarantee automatic playback.

scenes.title: Request apps and inputs
scenes.narration: Scroll within Movie Center to find app and input shortcuts. A request works only where the selected TV protocol supports it. An app tile does not include a streaming subscription or guarantee the service is installed.

scenes.title: Understand input selection
scenes.narration: Input controls vary by television. Some models can select an input directly; others can only open the TV source menu. Check the actual TV screen and make any remaining selection there.

scenes.title: Use the TV keyboard
scenes.narration: Open the microphone or keyboard button on the remote. Type a search or other TV text, then send it. Use ordinary non-sensitive text: some television control protocols use unencrypted local connections.

scenes.title: Choose whether to use voice
scenes.narration: Voice input is optional. Read the microphone explanation before continuing. Your Android speech provider may process audio on its servers. You can choose typed input instead; basic remote buttons do not need microphone access.

scenes.title: Open numbers and color keys
scenes.narration: The dial-pad button opens channel numbers and color keys. Use these only where your TV supports them. Close the sheet to return to the remote. Sending a number does not guarantee a particular channel exists.

scenes.title: Manage saved televisions
scenes.narration: Open TVs and Setup to see saved devices and rooms. Select a TV to make it active. The heart marks favorites. Removing a TV deletes its saved profile and pairing credentials from GlintBeam.

scenes.title: Switch devices and rooms
scenes.narration: With more than one saved TV, use the top device selector or room filters to find the right one. Always check which TV is active before sending power, volume, search, or other commands.

scenes.title: Add another television
scenes.narration: Choose Add TV to open the four-step wizard. Select the brand and read its preparation checklist. Prepare the television’s network-control settings before scanning. The wizard is separate from the initial tutorial.

scenes.title: Discover an additional TV
scenes.narration: The wizard shows discovered devices for the selected brand. Select the intended television, or enter its network address manually. Example names and addresses shown in this guide must be replaced with your own TV details.

scenes.title: Verify authorization
scenes.narration: Follow the authorization instructions for the selected television. Allow its prompt or enter its required code. Wait for a verified result before proceeding. Do not treat a pending handshake as successful pairing.

scenes.title: Check compatibility and save
scenes.narration: In the compatibility step, try the displayed test buttons and check the television for the result. Name the device and assign its room. Only save once the app’s required verification steps are satisfied.

scenes.title: Read the Brand Guide
scenes.narration: The Brand Guide tab contains preparation instructions and protocol-specific information. Select your manufacturer. Use your television’s own settings and documentation where menu names differ. This guide does not certify every model from a brand.

scenes.title: LG authorization
scenes.narration: For LG, follow the TV’s registration or pairing prompt and wait for authorization. Features vary by model and supported protocol. A network connection alone is not proof that GlintBeam has permission to control the TV.

scenes.title: Sony IP Control
scenes.narration: Sony uses its separate IP Control path, with the TV’s PIN or configured pre-shared key where required. This is different from native Android TV remote pairing. Use only settings and televisions you are authorized to manage.

scenes.title: Vizio pairing
scenes.narration: For Vizio, use the pairing information requested by the television and wait for authentication. Check each operation on the TV screen. Do not assume every app, input, or button is available on every model.

scenes.title: Roku connection
scenes.narration: Roku uses its local network-control interface and does not require an invented pairing PIN. Enable network control where the TV requires it. GlintBeam still needs to verify the device before treating the connection as ready.

scenes.title: Android TV limitation
scenes.narration: Native Android and Google TV remote pairing is not available in this GlintBeam version. The presence of a brand-guide entry does not make that protocol supported. Some Sony TVs may use the separate Sony IP Control path.

scenes.title: Review the preparation checklist
scenes.narration: Scroll through the selected Brand Guide for its preparation checklist and capability notes. If a connection fails, review these settings first. Only change television settings you understand and have permission to change.

scenes.title: Find privacy information
scenes.narration: Privacy and Info is available at the top of the app, including during setup. Read how local profiles, TV requests, optional speech processing, and support messages are handled. Microphone audio is not received by A. I Looplabs.

scenes.title: Read usage information
scenes.narration: The Usage tab explains network risks, TV compatibility, and third-party charges. GlintBeam itself has no account, advertising, or in-app purchases in this version. Television services may still have their own charges and terms.

scenes.title: Get help and continue
scenes.narration: The Licenses tab lists software and font notices. For help, use the support link on the GlintBeam website. You can replay any chapter, read the written guide, or return to the quick start whenever you need it.
